claim: Eight of ten scheduled pilot projects were online at the cutoff.

scope.population: The ten projects in the scheduled pilot cohort
scope.measure: Projects online at the reporting cutoff

sources.title: Synthetic pilot report for demonstration
sources.supports: Eight of ten scheduled projects were online; 12 of 40 requested megawatts were consumed.
sources.limits: The project count cannot establish an 80% consumed/requested power ratio or the state of all proposed projects.

rival_explanation: The project-count percentage and consumed/requested power ratio use different units and denominators.

check.action: Read the retained synthetic report and calculate each ratio separately.
check.observable: Project-count proportion and consumed/requested megawatt ratio
check.horizon: One reading of the retained synthetic report
check.decision_rule: Use 80% only for the scheduled project count and 30% for the consumed/requested power ratio.
check.falsifier: The retained report's cohort definition or totals differ from the claim.

limitations: Synthetic fixture only. No factual result about real projects or experiment outcome is established.
